crossRefs.note: “See now that I myself am he. There is no god with me. I kill and I make alive. I wound and I heal. There is no one who…
For I lift up my hand to heaven and declare, as I live forever,
But as for me, I know that my Redeemer lives. In the end, he will stand upon the earth.
He will call to me, ‘You are my Father, my God, and the rock of my salvation!’
My spirit has rejoiced in God my Savior,

parallels.note: Yahweh lives! Blessed be my rock. Exalted be the God of my salvation,

translations.web: Yahweh lives! Blessed be my rock! Exalted be God, the rock of my salvation,
translations.bsb: The LORD lives, and blessed be my Rock! And may God, the Rock of my salvation, be exalted—
translations.kjv: The LORD liveth; and blessed be my rock; and exalted be the God of the rock of my salvation.
translations.asv: Jehovah liveth; And blessed be my rock; And exalted be God, the rock of my salvation,
